summary: The open-access Phaseolean RCT (39170208; 66 adults with BMI 25-35, 1500 or 3000 mg/day for 45 days) reduced body weight by about 2 kg versus 0.13 kg on placebo, plus BMI and circumferences, in a small sponsor-funded trial. The 2026 meta-analysis (42066439) is abstract-only. Credit is narrowed to Phaseolean-labeled products for weight and body composition in adults with overweight or obesity, within Dr. Pham's 'confirm exact contexts, no blanket approval' instruction. Fourth-ruling boundary applied: limited credit, glycemic/carb-blocker positioning excluded.

applicability.studied_population: Adults aged 18-50 with BMI 25-35 taking Phaseolean 1500-3000 mg/day before meals for 45 days; not people at a healthy weight or other white kidney bean extracts.
applicability.reason: Reviewed preparation, population and purpose scope remains independent of amount. Dose reports descriptive research-exposure correspondence; it does not create a positive adequacy benchmark or Safety determination. 2026-10-28 agent review: only the open-access Phaseolean RCT was verifiable; credit narrowed to Phaseolean-labeled products. The 2026 meta-analysis remains unverified.

identity.standardization: Standardized water extract of Phaseolus vulgaris (white kidney bean) with alpha-amylase inhibitory activity; activity units not verified in this session

population.description: 66 adults aged 18-50 with BMI 25-35 kg/m2 (22 per arm), non-pregnant/non-lactating, willing to reduce weight; 62 completed.

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single-centre three-arm trial (CTRI/2023/02/049440); dietary habits and physical activity maintained.

outcomes.name: Body weight change at 45 days: -2.10 kg (1500 mg/day) and -1.94 kg (3000 mg/day) versus -0.13 kg placebo, p<0.01
BMI, body fat, skinfold thickness and waist/hip/thigh circumference reduced in both Phaseolean arms versus placebo (p<0.01)

limitations: Small (62 completers), short (45 days), single-centre trial funded by Ambe Phytoextracts; three authors are employed by the sponsor. No primary endpoint is designated in the article.
The lower dose outperformed the higher dose, so no dose-response or minimum effective dose is established.
Results apply to the Phaseolean extract only; generic white kidney bean powder or extracts without matching alpha-amylase activity are not equivalent.
Declared meta-analysis 42066439 (8 RCTs, 543 adults; weight MD -1.62 kg) has no open full text and supplies no verified context.
Exact extract activity not generic powder; table denominator inconsistency 18 vs 19 high-dose (prior extraction, retained).

Dr. Pham's fourth ruling set (2026-10-28) boundary: limited credit for the studied standardized Phaseolean extract and regimen only (66 enrolled, 45 days, manufacturer-employed investigators); the brand name alone is not maximum credit, and no glycemic benefit was shown.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

dose.administration_frequency: Two capsules three times daily before meals (500 or 1000 mg per meal)
co_therapies: Usual dietary habits and physical activity maintained

dose.reported_regimen: 1500 mg/day (250 mg capsules) or 3000 mg/day (500 mg capsules), two capsules before each of three meals, 45 days

normalization.basis: Assigned Phaseolean extract mass per day; not a generic white-kidney-bean benchmark.
